ArgoCD Deployment Platform - user guide (Confluence IT · system_guide · by Siddharth Jain · last updated 2026-04-30)
**System ID:** SYS-27 | **Owner team:** Cloud Infrastructure & Security | **Criticality:** critical | **Category:** dev-tooling | **Updated:** 2026-04-30

## What it is
GitOps continuous delivery for all Kubernetes workloads. Production deployments happen by merging to the environment repo; ArgoCD reconciles automatically. Replaced Jenkins in late 2025.

## How to get access
Read access for all engineers via Okta. Sync/rollback rights per application are granted to the owning team's GitHub team automatically. Cluster-admin is restricted to Cloud Infrastructure.

## Common tasks
- Every environment is described in the algoworks-deploy repo; merging a reviewed PR to an environment directory deploys it.
- A merged algoworks-deploy PR is the approval record for standard application deployments - no CHG is needed for image tag, replica, resource or feature-flag config changes to an existing service.
- Rollback = 'Rollback' in the ArgoCD UI to the previous revision (under 2 minutes) or revert the PR.
- Infrastructure, network, identity, database and new services still need a CHG and CAB.

## Known issues and gotchas
- The Change Management Policy page (v2) predates ArgoCD and still says all deployments need a CHG - the CAB decision of September 2025 is the operating rule.
- Apps in the Singapore standby show Healthy with 0 replicas by design.

## Support
Cloud Infrastructure (#devops-sre).

APM, infrastructure metrics, logs, synthetics and alerting for the production platform. Alerts route to PagerDuty schedules defined in the On-Call & Escalation Policy.

Standard (read) role for all engineers via Okta group. Non-engineering viewer access (e.g. TAMs for customer dashboards) requires Cloud Infrastructure Lead approval. Admin restricted to Cloud Infrastructure.

Cloud Infrastructure (#devops-sre).

title: Snowflake Data Warehouse - user guide — What it is / How to get access / Common tasks / Known issues and gotchas / Support

Snowflake Data Warehouse - user guide (Confluence ENG · system_guide · by Ananya Chatterjee · last updated 2026-06-23)
**System ID:** SYS-29 | **Owner team:** Data & Analytics Engineering | **Criticality:** high | **Category:** dev-tooling | **Updated:** 2026-06-23

## What it is
Central analytics warehouse: product telemetry, billing, CRM and support data modelled with dbt. Source for Metabase, the Customer 360 dashboard and FP&A reporting. Cost optimisation project in progress.

## How to get access
Governed by the Snowflake Data Access Policy. Curated schemas: Data Engineering Manager approval via a Jira DATA ticket. PII-tagged schemas: additionally require Data Protection Officer sign-off. Access is role-based (Okta group -> Snowflake role).

- Query timeouts on a small warehouse: ask in #eng-data before requesting a bigger warehouse - a curated dashboard may exist.

Data Engineering (#eng-data).

Data Engineering (#eng-data).

- Before April 2026 a manager attestation could substitute for the training; some users granted under that route may not have completed the course.

Platform Backend (#eng-platform); access via the IAM queue.

title: Engineering onboarding guide — Week one / How we ship
text:
Engineering onboarding guide (Confluence ENG · process_page · by Rohan Mehta, Priya Shah · last updated 2026-07-24)
**Owner:** Engineering (Rohan Mehta) | **Updated:** 24 July 2026

## Week one
- Your role bundle gives you GitHub, Jira, Datadog (read) and the AWS sandbox; your manager requests anything else (production read-only, Snowflake) via the ServiceNow catalog.
- Buddy: assigned by your manager; weekly check-ins for 30 days.
- Mandatory LearnHub: Security Awareness, Code of Conduct; 'Handling Customer Data' if you will use the Admin Console.
- Read: Code Review & Branch Protection Standard, Incident Management SOP, On-Call policy, ADR-014 (v4 API), the March 2026 postmortem.

## How we ship
- Merge to `main` with a CODEOWNER review and green CI. Promote via a PR in `algoworks-deploy`; ArgoCD does the rest.
- **Do I need a CHG?** For a standard application deployment (image tag, replicas, resources, feature-flag config of an existing service): **no** - the merged algoworks-deploy PR is the approval (CAB decision, September 2025). For Terraform/infrastructure, network, Okta configuration, database schema or parameters, new services or new external endpoints: **yes**, raise a CHG for the Tuesday/Thursday CAB. *The Change Management Policy page has not yet been updated to say this; the rule here is the operating one.*
- **Fridays:** deployments allowed before 14:00 IST if behind a feature flag or trivially reversible; stay online until 16:00. Month-end billing freeze (last two business days) still applies. Mobile releases follow the 48-hour internal-track soak.
- Pool/limit/timeout changes: separate PR with the `high-risk-config` label and a second reviewer.

## Monthly rhythm
- **20th:** expense claims cut-off for this month's payroll reimbursement.
- **BD-2:** freeze on vendor bills dated in the closing month; no production deployments touching billing until BD+1.
- **BD+6:** books locked.
- **Wednesdays:** vendor payment run (invoices in by Monday 17:00, quoting the PO number).

## Expenses (Zoho Expense)
Itemised receipts, correct category, manager then Finance AP approval. Per-diem days: no separate meal claims. If Zoho auto-rejects a claim you believe is valid (age, per-diem rate), raise a ticket in the Finance queue - AP reviews exceptions individually.

## Buying something
| Value | What you need |
|---|---|
| Up to Rs 25,000 | Team lead OK; expense or corporate card |
| Rs 25,001 - 1,00,000 | Purchase request; Department Head |
| Rs 1,00,001 - 5,00,000 | Purchase request; Department Head + AP & Procurement Manager; Security review for software |
| Above Rs 5,00,000 | Above + CFO; Vendor Onboarding SOP (quotes / single-source justification) |
New vendors need the vendor form, GSTIN/PAN, bank verification by call-back and, for SaaS, the Security questionnaire. Allow two weeks for a new vendor.

**Owner:** People Operations (Swati Kulkarni) | **Updated:** 3 August 2026

Thank you for being a buddy. You are the new joiner's first friendly face, not their manager or IT.

## Before Day 1
- Check with the manager that the onboarding ticket (auto-created from Darwinbox ~10 business days before start) shows the laptop and default bundle as ready.
- Book a 30-minute coffee for Day 1 afternoon and a weekly 30-minute check-in for four weeks.

## Day 1
- Meet them after HR induction (finishes 11:00). Show them the floor, the pantry, the printers, the meeting-room booking in Outlook.
- Slack: #general, #new-joiners, #it-helpdesk, #kudos, your team channels. Encourage them to introduce themselves in #new-joiners.
- Point them to LearnHub for the mandatory modules (due in 30 days).

## Weeks 1-4
- Explain how your team actually works: which days you come in, where decisions are written down, who to ask for what.
- If they are missing an application, tell the manager to raise it via the ServiceNow catalog; role bundles cover the basics only.
- Flag to the manager or HRBP if something feels off - early is better.

## Hybrid work
Office days are set by each department head; check with the manager what the team does and say so plainly. (HR Ops will point to the Hybrid Work Policy; the department practice may differ while the policy is being updated.)

title: Deal Desk process - discounts, approvals and non-standard terms — When you need Deal Desk / Discount approvals (as configured in CPQ from April 2026) / What Deal Desk checks / Turnaround
text:
Deal Desk process - discounts, approvals and non-standard terms (Confluence SALES · process_page · by Arun Prasad · last updated 2026-05-04)
**Owner:** Sales Operations & Deal Desk (Arun Prasad) | **Updated:** 4 May 2026

## When you need Deal Desk
Any discount above 10%, any payment terms beyond Net-45, custom SLAs, or liability changes. CPQ creates the Deal Desk ticket automatically when you submit a quote above 10%.

## Discount approvals (as configured in CPQ from April 2026)
| Discount on TCV | Approver |
|---|---|
| Up to 10% | You (recorded on the opportunity) |
| 10.01-20% | Enterprise Sales Manager / Head of Customer Success (renewals) |
| 20.01-30% | VP Sales (CFO receives a weekly report of all approvals above 20%) |
| Above 30% | CEO |
_Note: the Discount Approval Matrix page shows the CFO for 20-30%; CPQ reflects the February 2026 agreement between the VP Sales and CFO, and a v4 of the matrix is in progress. Follow CPQ._

## What Deal Desk checks
Discount calculation (free months count), competitor context, multi-year TCV basis, that the approval is recorded on both the ticket and the opportunity before the quote is sent, and that Chargebee is only updated from an approved quote.

## Turnaround
Same business day for approvals within Sales; allow two days when Legal or the CFO are involved.

title: How to report a security incident or a phishing email — Phishing or suspicious email / Other security incidents / What happens next / Reminders
text:
How to report a security incident or a phishing email (Confluence IT · process_page · by Amit Saxena · last updated 2026-05-04)
**Owner:** IAM & Security (Amit Saxena) | **Updated:** 4 May 2026 | **Classification:** Internal

## Phishing or suspicious email
Click **Report Phish** in Outlook (desktop, web and mobile). That is all you need to do; Security sees it within minutes. If you clicked a link or entered your password: call the Service Desk (ext. 200) immediately - you will not be in trouble, and speed matters far more than embarrassment.

## Other security incidents
Lost or stolen laptop/phone, credentials shared by mistake, suspected account compromise, data sent to the wrong recipient, unusual system behaviour: post in **#security** (private - ask to be added) or call the Service Desk out of hours. Do not investigate on your own.

## What happens next
Security classifies the incident (Incident Management SOP severities apply; a credential compromise is P1), contains it (sessions revoked, factors reset, devices wiped where needed), and follows up with you. Postmortems are blameless.

## Reminders
- AlgoWorks never asks for passwords or bank changes by email; vendor bank changes go through Finance AP with a call-back.
- Credentials belong in 1Password shared vaults, never in Slack, email or documents.
- Quarterly phishing simulations run under the Security Awareness programme; clicking one leads to a short refresher, nothing else.

Use Zendesk macros for standard updates. Commitments beyond the SLA table need the Head of Customer Success. Incident comms to customers are drafted by CS and reviewed by Marketing (Sanya Kapadia) before sending. Credits follow the Discount Approval Matrix thresholds via Deal Desk.

title: Remote work setup guide — Before you leave the office / At home / Security / Equipment / Time zones
text:
Remote work setup guide (Confluence IT · reference · by Shruti Joshi · last updated 2026-06-30)
**Owner:** IT Service Desk | **Updated:** 30 June 2026

## Before you leave the office
Install from the Company Portal: GlobalProtect, Okta Verify (phone), 1Password, Slack, Zoom. Test the VPN once from the office guest network.

## At home
- VPN is needed only for internal tools (Admin Console, Metabase, Snowflake, restricted Confluence, file shares). Email, Slack, Salesforce, Zendesk, GitHub work without it.
- Router MTU problems show up as 'connects then drops'; IAM can push a lower MTU for your gateway profile.
- Use the company laptop only. Personal phones can run Outlook/Teams with Intune app protection.

## Security
Lock your screen, do not use public Wi-Fi without VPN, report lost devices immediately. Restricted data (payroll, contracts, customer PII) must not be downloaded to personal devices or printed at home.

## Equipment
The office does not reimburse home monitors or chairs (Hybrid Work Policy). Designated remote employees may request a monitor from the Service Desk (shipped once). Connectivity allowances are decided by Finance - check with Finance AP for the current position.

## Time zones
Core collaboration hours 11:00-16:00 IST. Singapore and US staff overlap at least 3 hours; use the Outlook scheduling assistant.
